import base64
	name=event.file.name
	
	ext=name.split(".")[-1]
	
	mime_types = {
	    'png': 'image/png',
	    'jpg': 'image/jpeg',
	    'jpeg': 'image/jpeg',
	    'gif': 'image/gif',
	    'svg': 'image/svg+xml',
	    # Add more mappings if necessary
	}
	# Function to convert file bytes to a base64-encoded string
	def convert_file_to_base64(file_bytes, ext):
		# Open the image file in binary mode
		base64_encoded_data = base64.b64encode(file_bytes)
		# Convert bytes to string (Python 2.7)
		base64_string = base64_encoded_data.decode('utf-8')
		mime_type = mime_types[ext.lower()]
		data_url_prefix = 'data:{};base64,'.format(mime_type)
		return data_url_prefix + base64_string
		
	sdata = event.file.getBytes()
	base64_image_string = convert_file_to_base64(sdata, ext)
	uuid=self.view.params.uuid
	self.view.custom.params.config.base64=base64_image_string

import json
	from exchange.architecturebuilder.files import save_file_to_directory, read_file
	from com.inductiveautomation.ignition.gateway import IgnitionGateway
	context = IgnitionGateway.get()
	projectParentFolder = str(context.systemManager.dataDir.absoluteFile).replace('\\','/')
	directory_path = projectParentFolder + '/savedFiles/customComponents'
	file_name = 'customComponents'
	
	currentData=str(read_file('{}/{}.json'.format(directory_path,file_name)))
	try:
		self.parent.custom.fileContents=json.loads(currentData)
	except:
		self.parent.custom.fileContents={"customComponents":[]}
	params=system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.view.custom.params))
	name=params['name']
	params['config']['connections']=[]
	data={"customComponents":system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.parent.custom.fileContents.customComponents))}
	
	updated = False
	
	# Overwrite logic
	for component in data["customComponents"]:
		if component["name"] == params["name"]:
			component.update(params)
			updated = True
			break
	
	# Append the new item if not updated
	if not updated:
		data["customComponents"].append(params)
	
	
	saved=save_file_to_directory(file_name, directory_path, data)
	if saved==True:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("componentAdded", True)
